en.headline: Driver freed after car moves outside Prince Edward bar
en.dek: A 29-year-old man suffered a minor right-knee injury after he was trapped between a BYD and a Volkswagen in Sai Yeung Choi Street North.
body: A driver was trapped between two cars outside a bar in Prince Edward early on Sunday and freed with a minor injury, Hong Kong 01 and Sing Tao reported.

Police received a report at about 5am that a man was caught between vehicles outside 161 Sai Yeung Choi Street North. Reports said a 29-year-old man had driven a BYD private car to collect four men from a bar, got out without switching off the engine, and stood between the BYD and a white Volkswagen while trying to get the group into the car.

The reports said the passengers, suspected to have been drinking, moved around inside the BYD and that one of them was believed to have pressed a control, sending the car forward. The driver was trapped for several minutes. Firefighters moved the BYD and ambulance staff took him to hospital conscious, with a minor right-knee injury.
Police attended with a dog after the scene became disordered. A preliminary check found no criminal element, the reports said. The BYD's front and the Volkswagen's rear were slightly dented.

zh.headline: 太子酒吧外私家車駛前 司機被夾輕傷
zh.dek: 29歲男司機在西洋菜北街被夾在比亞迪與福士之間數分鐘，右膝輕傷清醒送院。
body: 周日凌晨，太子一間酒吧對開有司機被夾在兩車之間，獲救時右膝輕傷。《香港01》及《星島日報》報道。
警方約凌晨5時接報，西洋菜北街161號一間酒吧對開有男子被夾在兩車之間。報道指，一名29歲男子駕駛比亞迪私家車到場接載四名在酒吧消遣的男子，下車時沒有熄匙，站在比亞迪與一輛白色福士私家車之間安排眾人上車。
報道稱，車上人士懷疑受酒精影響，在車廂內爬動，相信有人觸動按鈕，比亞迪隨即向前駛。男司機被夾數分鐘。消防將比亞迪移開，救護員其後把他送院，他當時清醒，右膝受輕傷。
現場一度混亂，警方帶同警犬到場。報道指，初步調查相信事件沒有刑事成份。比亞迪車頭及福士車尾輕微凹陷。
